senses.definition_en: sanctity; holiness

examples.english: Today, the name of Casilda de Toledo is almost unmetioned in the saint-day calendar on the account, loathesome to many, of which the contrite, penitent nothingness there had been swept away, in spite of itself, beyond its holiness by the speed of our tired age of mistreatments and uncertainties, or by some of my relatives’ arrogance.
examples.ref: 2018 July 29, “Casilda de Toledo”, in El Nacional:
examples.text: Hoy, el nombre de Casilda de Toledo casi no se menciona en el santoral acaso por el hecho, deplorable para muchos, de que la nada contrita penitente haya sido arrastrada, a pesar suyo, fuera de su santidad por la velocidad de nuestra agobiada época de maltratos e incertidumbres o por la echonería de algunos miembros de mi familia.
examples.translation: Today, the name of Casilda de Toledo is almost unmetioned in the saint-day calendar on the account, loathesome to many, of which the contrite, penitent nothingness there had been swept away, in spite of itself, beyond its holiness by the speed of our tired age of mistreatments and uncertainties, or by some of my relatives’ arrogance.

glosses: sanctity; holiness
